records.context: The cell level follows brieflow. Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT licence) reduces a gene as the median of all of its cells (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` by ``gene_symbol_0``). A guide with many cells then weighs more than one with few, where the guide level gives every guide one vote. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the cell level raised mean retrieval mAP from 0.0602 to 0.0639 in TVN space.

records.review_basis: identical English block moved to a new index by item 937; translation carried over from the earlier reviewed record
records.source: THE CELL LEVEL FOLLOWS BRIEFLOW. Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT licence) reduces a gene as the median of all of its cells (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` by ``gene_symbol_0``). A guide with many cells then weighs more than one with few, where the guide level gives every guide one vote. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the cell level raised mean retrieval mAP from 0.0602 to 0.0639 in TVN space.
records.translation: 细胞层级遵循 BRIEFLOW。Brieflow（Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow，MIT 许可证）将基因汇总为其所有细胞的中位数（``lib.aggregate.aggregate``，按 ``gene_symbol_0``）。这样细胞多的向导比细胞少的向导权重更大，而向导层级给每个向导一票。在 Funk et al. 2022 的板 A 上，细胞层级使 TVN 空间中的平均 retrieval mAP 从 0.0602 提高到 0.0639。
